description: Returns a number that represents the date in the date-time code.

params.description: A number from 1900 or 1904 (depending on the workbook's date system) to 9999.
params.name: arg1

params.description: A number from 1 to 12 representing the month of the year.
params.name: arg2

params.description: A number from 1 to 31 representing the day of the month.
params.name: arg3

signature: DATE(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg2: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg3: ApiRange | ApiName | number): number
